messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays that create long‑weekend stretches in 2023. (All dates are in the local time zone of the holiday’s province; the “long weekend” period is shown as the Friday‑to‑Monday span that includes the holiday.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | **Fri Dec 30 – Mon Jan 2** |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Monday Feb 20 | **Fri Feb 17 – Mon Feb 20** |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | **Fri Apr 7 – Mon Apr 10** |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | **Fri May 19 – Mon May 22** |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | **Fri Jun 30 – Mon Jul 3** |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | **Fri Sep 1 – Mon Sep 4** |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | **Fri Oct 6 – Mon Oct 9** |
| Remembrance Day | Monday Nov 11 | **Fri Nov 8 – Mon Nov 11** |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | **Fri Dec 22 – Mon Dec 25** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. George’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.).  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can add those provincial holidays to the list.
